captions.detailed: A professional DSLR camera flash unit designed with a matte black body and a flat mounting foot. The rear face of the main control body features a small central display screen surrounded by six small, rectangular, light-grey control buttons. Above the body, a dual-arm yoke supports the forward-facing flash head, which features a translucent off-white rectangular light diffuser lens. The entire head assembly swivels horizontally on a vertical revolute joint above the body, and the head pitches vertically on a horizontal revolute joint between the yoke arms, with each rear button acting as an independent small prismatic push control.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an articulated DSLR camera flash accessory. The model should feature a tall, black main body with a mounting foot and a rear control panel containing a small screen and several small, light-grey rectangular buttons. Mount a forward-facing flash head with an off-white diffuser lens between two yoke arms, enabling a horizontal swivel joint above the body, a horizontal pitch joint for the flash head, and prismatic movement for each button.
captions.factory: Construct the camera flash using a multi-part assembly. Build the base plate and main body using extruded boxes with chamfered or tapered profiles, and model the rear screen and buttons as separate small boxes translated onto the rear face. Create the yoke using a horizontal cross-bar and two vertical upright arms. Model the flash head by extruding a main housing block and adding a thin, colored rectangular face for the diffuser lens. Define a continuous vertical revolute joint between the main body and the yoke, a horizontal revolute joint between the yoke and the flash head, and individual prismatic joints for each of the six rear-panel buttons.
